task_title: Support exact configured execution scope after explicit Step 5 resume

criterion_1.statement: Replace obsolete unconditional lexical S5 prohibition with explicit trusted issuer configuration of exact allowed task IDs. Default configuration must remain TRACE-only (DEV502-TRACE-001 in pantheon-dev) and fail closed on Step 5. Wildcards, non-list, empty, or unknown scopes must fail closed.
criterion_1.evidence: ExecutionGrantIssuerService implements validate_allowed_tasks and validate_allowed_environments, strictly rejecting None, non-list, empty, wildcards (*, ?, all, any), and whitespace. validate_task_policy rejects unlisted S5 tasks with explicit fail-closed message. Default allowed_tasks remains ('DEV502-TRACE-001',) and allowed_environments remains ('pantheon-dev',). All six canonical S5 IDs (S5-PAIR-001, S5-LOOPS-001, S5-PROVENANCE-001, S5-JOURNEYS-001, S5-ROLLBACK-001, S5-REPORT-001) fail closed on default configuration. Explicitly configured S5 tasks succeed with valid cryptographic binding and canonical verification.

criterion_2.statement: Provide documented explicit-resume example configuration listing only the six existing canonical S5 task IDs and pantheon-dev; do not enable on live issuer. The request CLI must support requesting exact task IDs without inventing local authorization authority.
criterion_2.evidence: deploy/execution-grant-issuer/issuer-config.step5-resume.example.json lists exclusively the six canonical S5 task IDs and 'pantheon-dev'. run_server.py loads and validates the configuration. scripts/request_execution_grant.py validates task eligibility against canonical task contract without local ID restrictions; authorization authority resides in issuer service and canonical task state. docs/operations/execution-grant-issuer.md and deploy/execution-grant-issuer/README.md updated with configuration runbook and Step 5 explicit resume guidance.

criterion_3.statement: Deliver focused CI-wired tests and comprehensive evidence under docs/deployment/evidence/OPS-EXECUTION-SCOPE-RESUME-001/. Ensure all simulation fixtures are explicitly labeled. Preserve clean worktree, commit trailers, and pass local acceptance.
criterion_3.evidence: Added test_validate_allowed_tasks_fails_closed, test_validate_allowed_environments_fails_closed, test_default_config_denies_all_six_canonical_s5_tasks, test_configured_s5_allowed_tasks_accepts_configured_task_with_valid_binding, test_configured_s5_issuer_denies_unlisted_s5_and_unknown_tasks, test_configured_s5_issuer_rejects_wrong_environment, test_configured_s5_issuer_rejects_tampered_policy_digest, test_configured_s5_issuer_rejects_missing_mfa, test_configured_s5_issuer_rejects_replayed_challenge in test_issuer.py; TestRunServiceExecutionScopeConfiguration in test_run_server.py; and S5 CLI request/issue/submit integration tests in test_request_execution_grant.py. All fixtures are explicitly labeled as simulations. Acceptance smoke suite passes 100%.
